issues.legal_issue: An order transferring a pending suit from a subordinate court to a High Court for trial is not a judgment appealable under the Letters Patent when it neither determines the merits of the suit nor ends it.
material_facts: A plaintiff brought a suit for possession in a subordinate court and later applied to have it transferred to the High Court for trial, alleging a reasonable apprehension that a fair trial would not be obtained locally.
The High Court allowed the transfer application. An appeal against that order was dismissed as incompetent because the transfer order was not a judgment.
The Supreme Court considered whether the transfer order qualified as a judgment for the purpose of an appeal under the Letters Patent.
issues.conclusion: The transfer order was not a judgment appealable under clause 15 of the Letters Patent. The appeal was incompetent, and the appeal to the Supreme Court was dismissed with costs.
issues.legal_principle: Under clause 15 of the Letters Patent, a judgment must determine a right or liability affecting the merits of the controversy or dispose of or terminate the proceeding. The Court relied on the approach in The Justices of the Peace for Calcutta v. Oriental Gas Co. and Tuljaram v. Alagappa, while concluding that a transfer order meets neither test: the suit remains alive and proceeds in another court. It distinguished orders concerning leave to sue under clause 12, which may end the suit or decide a vital point going to its foundation, and rejected the reasoning in Krishna Reddi v. Thanikachala insofar as it treated a transfer order as appealable on that basis. The Court did not attempt an exhaustive definition of “judgment.”

rule.if: letters_patent_appeal_from_transfer_order and transfer_order_only_changes_forum and underlying_suit_remains_pending and order_does_not_determine_merits

predicates.letters_patent_appeal_from_transfer_orde: The proceeding is an appeal under a Letters Patent against an order transferring a pending suit.
predicates.transfer_order_only_changes_forum: The order changes the court that will hear the suit without otherwise disposing of it.
predicates.underlying_suit_remains_pending: The same suit remains pending and is to continue in the receiving court.
predicates.order_does_not_determine_merits: The order does not decide the merits of the parties’ underlying controversy.

issues.definition: When an appeal under a Letters Patent challenges an order that only changes the forum, leaves the same suit pending, and does not determine its merits, the order is not appealable as a judgment.
